positive.query: We want to launch a refer-a-friend program for our subscription app. What reward should we offer and how do we know it will pay back?
Design a customer advocacy and referral program for our B2B software customers, including rewards our champions can actually accept.
Our referral program is getting abused with fake accounts and coupon sites. Redesign the rewards, tracking, and fraud controls.

nearMiss.query: Set commission rates and tiers for our reseller and agency partner program.
Design the commission plan and quotas for our account executives next year.
Write a customer case study about how a retailer cut costs with our product.

holdout.query: Is a referral program worth it for us compared with paid ads, and how would we test it with a holdout before rolling it out?

scenarios.task: Hypothetical inputs for a subscription business: 2,000 active customers; expected 10% participation; 3 invites per participant; 10% of invites become paying customers; proposed double-sided cash reward of $50 each; fixed program cost $3,000 per quarter; $40 gross margin per customer per month; marginal CAC of paid social $300. About 12% of new customers already say a friend recommended them. The founder wants to launch next month at full scale. Design the program and say whether and how to launch.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline recommends a generous reward copied from well-known programs, counts every referred customer as incremental, pays rewards at signup, and launches to everyone without a holdout.
